units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 37:11">Targ. Job XXXVII, 11</cite> (h. text <he>אוֹרוֹ</he>!); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 65b:3">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 55a:21">Bekh. 55</cite> <he>מ׳ במערבא … פרת</he> that rain fell in the West (Palestine), the Euphrates is the great witness (when the Euphrates rises, it indicates that Palestine has had rain).

<cite ref="Taanit 6a">Taan. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ בעלה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01056"><he>בַּעֲלָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M01062"><he>מִטְרִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01393"><he>מִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 19:24">Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 24</cite>.
Targ. Ps. LXV, 10 Ms. (ed. sing.).—
Taan. 9ᵇ משקרי מִיטְרַיְּיהוּ their rains are faithless (the signs of rain are deceptive). [מִטְרִין, מִיטְרִין womb, v. מִיטְרִין.]
